blocks.text: Whalley homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Whalley, September 2026. Detached houses: 86 listed at month end and 0 sold in September, a sales ratio of —. Condos and townhomes: 635 listed at month end and 40 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 10 over 4 months against an average of 84.8 listed, about 33.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 4 sold. condos and townhomes sold 209 over 4 months against an average of 622.2 listed, about 11.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 65 sold.
